name: Guard policy fail-closed behavior
source_description: Curated seed for guard and policy implementation work.

body.summary: Guard and policy work should route through native guard pipeline behavior, policy validation and compiler code, and fail-closed tests. Guard denial and redaction evidence must remain connected to receipt and conformance surfaces.
constraints: Invalid policies reject at load time.
Guard and policy errors deny access.
Agents should inspect both runtime evaluator code and policy compiler code before changing guard semantics.
